How it works after a show

The website turns several incomplete lists into one clear checklist. It does not send anything by itself.

1

Collect the records

Save the event's attendee scans, then add Sandbar's business cards, voice notes and written list.

2

Find each person

The tool joins records that clearly describe the same person. If it is not sure, it stops that record for a person to check.

3

Check the next action

Read the prepared email drafts, calls, no-email decisions and safety checks. Every result includes a reason.

4

Check the 30-day result

Add the latest activity to count trials, booked demos, contact with no result and people who were not contacted.

Built around the way Sandbar works

Erin

Runs the review

Checks the total, record matches, permission, existing customers and anything that must be fixed before contact.

Owen

Completes his follow-up

Reads his prepared emails, adds prices or links, makes his calls and sends everything manually from Sandbar's normal tools.

Nadia

Owns the outcome

Reads her emails and French drafts, completes her calls and uses the 30-day totals to see whether Sandbar kept its promises.

Safe by default

  • Missing required inputs stop the run.
  • Uncertain people are flagged instead of silently merged.
  • Booked, contacted or blocked people do not receive another ordinary sales email.
  • Personal remarks stay out of prepared emails.
  • Nothing sends automatically.

Clear limits

  • Existing customers and earlier removal requests still require Erin's check.
  • Unrecorded conversations cannot be recovered.
  • Promises still need their owner to complete them.
  • Paying customers are measured later, not guessed at day 30.
  • Shared phone completion tracking is not included in this version.
